stateNote: Dry toast the chopped pecans until fragrant and slightly colored. This can either be done in a dry skillet on the stovetop over medium-high heat while stirring frequently or else by roasting the nuts in the oven on a cookie sheet while you prepare the batter. The stovetop method is faster but requires more attention. It is also possible to buy dry toasted nuts instead of raw to avoid this step. The pecans should be crunchy and nutty, not rubbery or mealy.
